description: SaveCrawlSettings: overwrites a project's matched Bing site's crawl-rate/AJAX-crawling config. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION — unlike get_bing_site_overview's GetCrawlSettings read, it writes to the operator's live Bing Webmaster account. crawlRate must have exactly 24 hourly values, per Bing's own documented CrawlSettings JSON sample. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

ajaxEnabled.description: Whether Bing should crawl AJAX content on this site.

crawlRate.description: Exactly 24 hourly crawl-rate values, one per hour of the day.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: save_bing_crawl_settings
